key_insight: Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA) aims to compress large datasets into small synthetic sets for self-supervised learning. The key idea is to preserve information that helps models learn consistent representations across different augmentations.
problem_solved: Most dataset distillation methods focus on supervised learning. Self-supervised distillation must preserve useful representation-learning signals without relying on class labels, including consistency across augmented views.
method: Introduce MIPA as a self-supervised dataset distillation approach.
